questions.audit: Which events, actor attribution, retention, and redaction apply?
questions.authentication: Which authentication mechanism and principal are required?
questions.authorization: Which actor, tenant, ownership, delegation, and state rules authorize this operation?
questions.clientBinding: Which callers consume this exact method and path and response?
questions.errors: Which errors, status codes, and disclosure constraints apply?
questions.examples: Which valid request and response examples are source-approved?
questions.idempotency: What duplicate, retry, concurrency, and replay rules apply?
questions.permission: Which governance permission authorizes this exact operation?
questions.persistence: Which storage mappings, transactions, and invariants apply?
questions.rateLimits: What scope, limit, window, and rejection behavior apply?
questions.request: What are the exact parameters, body schema, and bodyless semantics?
questions.response: What status codes and exact response schemas are approved?
questions.tests: What positive, negative, tenant-isolation, ownership, and state test cases prove the contract?
questions.validation: What validation bounds and unknown-field behavior are approved?
questions.version: What contract version and compatibility rules apply?
questions.workflow: What preconditions, transitions, and side effects are approved?
